issue.title: bob periods brief ignores done/ archive paths: archived tasks lose linked minutes and print dead source-note links

task_type_fields.impact: Every weekly Review drafted from the brief inherits wrong time attribution and links that don't resolve. The bob-cli-gr phase agents had to hand-correct targets to their `done/` homes, and they left out per-task minutes. The planned Monday automation (bob-cli-gp) would hit the same problem.
task_type_fields.repro:
`bob periods brief 2026-W43 -f md` (also W27–W39): the bob root (5h 20m, 21%) lists no tasks, though the week's daily notes link archived rows such as `done/bob_done#^root-parent`. Finished drops archived completions (W35 `done/sase_done#^fix-startup-time`, W34 `done/sase_done#^final`), and prints dead source-note targets such as `[[sase#^add-muse-to-pools]]` (W39) and `[[sase_install#^prj]]` (W27), whose blocks now live only in `done/sase_done.md` / `done/sase_install_done.md`. Dropped prints the same dead targets (W30 `sase#^opus-5`).

Root cause: archived tasks are indexed with `source_path` = the original note and `archive_path` = the `done/` file (`src/native/stats/index.rs`). `linked_minutes` only matches a Pomodoro link target against `normalize_target(&task.source_path)`. Session links point at `done/<note>_done`, so archived tasks get 0 minutes. `done_in_span` ranks by those minutes, so `finish_cap` (7) cuts them. `task_link` always renders `stem_of(&task.source_path)`. Fix: match a link against `archive_path` too, and render `archive_path` when it is set. Do this in `linked_minutes`, `linked_for`/`task_key`, and `task_link`.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-gr phase agents drafting the W27–W43 weekly Reviews (proposed by bob-cli-gr.1 note #1, bob-cli-gr.5 note #1, bob-cli-gr.17 note #1; corroborated in gr.7–gr.14) found that the brief ignores done/ archive paths.
